answer: Random peer audit blocks fake identities. An applicant stakes 40 POA and files a lotus record as proof of real work. A beacon draws 5 peers who check the record against a nectar flow log. A check compares it with a sable survey before peers vote; a majority pass releases the stake, a fail forfeits it. Forging 1,000 identities locks 40,000 POA plus forfeits, far above fake rewards. An honest agent pays once, passes, and earns undiluted rewards.
